question: If x + (1)/(x)=6, then x² + (1)/(x²)=?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any expression of the form x + 1/x = k, the value of x² + 1/x² is given by the direct formula **k² − 2**.

Given k = 6.

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 6² − 2

⇒ 36 − 2 = 34

**∴ The correct answer is 34.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** x + 1/x = 6

**Formula Used:** (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0998d6ed1c63f4ccdaac50fe23c899ccf3de8bc2fa386c7bc82e9b1d1e3cf10.png] 

Squaring both sides of the given equation:

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 6²

⇒ x² + (1/x)² + 2 × x × (1/x) = 36

⇒ x² + 1/x² + 2 = 36

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 36 − 2

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 34

**∴ The correct answer is 34.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Higher Power Relation (Cube)

If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k.

Negative Sign Identity

If x − 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² + 2.

Fourth Power Relation

To find x⁴ + 1/x⁴, square the result of (x² + 1/x²) and subtract 2.</p
